$comment: The step type engine as one copyable unit. The Step Type Builder repository pins an ATLAS Align revision and copies exactly these files, in this order. Raise engineVersion whenever a listed file changes behavior.

preview.$comment: Everything the builder's live preview page loads to render the real guided editor, English, automatic notes, Developer Logic, formulas, SQL/Python script fragments and qTest rows for a step without the rest of ATLAS. scripts is the complete page list in load order (it includes the engine scripts above where they load); after loading, call initPhraseCatalog() (it fetches ./catalogs/logic_phrase_catalog.json) and put the draft in a registry with ATLASStepTypeRuntime.useRegistry(). css follows the cascade order of styles.css. Checked by test/step-type-preview-scripts.test.js.
